title: TOOL_CALL_QUEUED payload
description: A tool call queued while the human dimension is Pend, or held for an answer under the detached-call policy; shown_hash is h_q, the hash of the tool, the permission and the content.

content.description: The call's content as hashed and as forwarded (null when none was supplied); retained so that the forwarded request is the hashed one.

held.description: True when queued with no escalation pending while no client was attached (detached_calls policy).
